triggers: the configured target venue is Nature Machine Intelligence
evidence_standards: Bind every venue requirement to a current official source, access date, and inspected excerpt or structured note.
Distinguish journal-wide guidance from article-type-specific requirements and from inferred style patterns.
Demonstrate audience fit, contribution fit, article-type fit, evidence sufficiency, and manuscript architecture separately.
Keep unverified or draft profile fields as explicit final-gate blockers.
safety_constraints: Do not claim submission readiness from a draft, stale, inferred, or unverified venue profile.
Do not represent automated reviewer passage as editorial acceptance or independent peer review.
Do not invent word limits, section rules, reference limits, data policies, or article-type requirements.
